notes: Setup – Done page: no widget check after a brand-new setup (nothing has been set up yet). “What next” is now three clear steps: set up the widgets on your screens, add your lists, notes and reminders, and set up the reward system if you’re using it. It explains that widgets needing a key, your council or a photo folder ask for it when you add or click them.
Widget check (when you run setup again on a working dashboard): widgets that simply aren’t set up yet show as “○ Not set up yet”, and temporary hiccups as “⏳”, instead of red problems.
Family Admin is now described as the app for adults / admins – notes, lists, reminders and settings first, and points and tasks only if you use the reward system.
